_comment: The S3 group policy Trident's StorageGRID driver generates for a ReadWrite
BucketAccess. One statement at the bucket level, one at the object level,
both scoped to only the buckets in the access and nothing else. Replace
<bucket-id> with the real bucket name from the Secret's COSI_S3_BUCKET_ID
field (trident-bc-<bucketclaim-uid>). A ReadOnly access drops PutObject,
DeleteObject, DeleteObjectVersion, the multipart-upload actions and the
object-tagging write actions, leaving only the list and read actions.
